=== Day 3: the town meeting ===
Agnes: "Oh, Last night, communing with the dead at Hollis's hearth, I learned they saw Bartholomew out on the Docks the night before you arrived."

Odette: "I have a perfectly good reason to suspect Merrin, which I shall share when it suits me."  [case board: #91]
Merrin: "Oh, a chill runs down my spine whenever Isolde passes—mark them well, neighbors!"  [case board: #92]
Isolde: "Please hear me gently, everyone—I only held back out of fear, but I am the Night Watch."
Isolde: "The night before you arrived, I watched the Market: nobody stirred."
Isolde: "On the first night, I watched the Market: I saw Merrin pass by."
Isolde: "Last night, I watched the Market: I saw Merrin pass by."
Isolde: "It pains me, truly, but I share Odette's fear about Merrin. I saw them out on the Market last night, while I was out on my duty."  [case board: #93, #94, #95, #96, #97]
Lian: "Here's what the town needs to know to narrow the list: I am the Psychologist."

Lian: "Last night, I learned that at least one of these two statements from day 2 was a lie or misreading: Nisha's Martyr reading (night 1); or Edda saying they saw Merrin on Chapel Hill (night 1)."
Lian: "I back Merrin's read on Isolde."  [case board: #98, #99, #30, #27, #100, #63, #59, #101]
